maddeler.e:
استوضحوا (form X)
# اِسْتَوْضَحُوا (istawḍaḥū) /is.taw.dˤa.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَوْضَحَ (istawḍaḥa)
# اُسْتُوضِحُوا (ustūḍiḥū) /us.tuː.dˤi.ħuː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِسْتَوْضَحَ (istawḍaḥa)
# اِسْتَوْضِحُوا (istawḍiḥū) /is.taw.dˤi.ħuː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَوْضَحَ (istawḍaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
